name: coin-catcher
description: Fast-paced arcade coin-catching game playable in modern desktop and mobile browsers.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Build check passed: pure static web assets.')"
scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const mime={'html':'text/html','css':'text/css','js':'application/javascript','svg':'image/svg+xml','json':'application/json','ico':'image/x-icon'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{const p=path.join(__dirname,req.url==='/'?'index.html':req.url.split('?')[0]);if(fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.statSync(p).isFile()){const ext=path.extname(p).slice(1);res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':mime[ext]||'text/plain'});fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);}else{res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}}).listen(8000,()=>console.log('Coin Catcher server running on http://localhost:8000'));"
